attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. It gives the life doxologia.ro had none of, and the one fact in it that places him: that he was a disciple of Anthony the Great, to whom the page sends the reader at 17 Ιανουαρίου.
